description: Fake miniature look: blur the top and bottom of your photo while keeping a sharp focus band — fully adjustable.

faqs.a: Tilt-shift blurs everything except a horizontal band, mimicking the shallow depth of field of a tilt-shift lens — the classic "tiny world" look.
Move the focus position slider to place the sharp band over your subject, and widen the band if the blur covers too much.
faqs.q: My subject is blurred — how do I fix it?

faqs.a: Yes — your photo is processed on a canvas in your browser and never uploaded.

howto: Choose a photo (aerial or high-angle shots work best).
Drag the focus position slider to center the sharp band on your subject.
Adjust band height and blur strength.
Click "Download image" to save the PNG.
title: Tilt Shift Effect
